_comment: Pre-encoding config for BabySlakh with the streamgen accompaniment control. 'controls' here names METADATA AUDIO KEYS returned by the custom_metadata_module under __audio__; each is VAE-encoded and fused, in this order, into {id}_controls.npy. The training-side config (preencoded/local_babyslakh_streamgen_preencoded.json) names the resulting LATENT controls and must list them in the same order. Augmentation: 'augment_variants' writes that many copies of the split, variant 0 unaugmented and the rest each rolling a time-stretch rate from 'augment_time_stretch' and a pitch shift from +/- 'augment_pitch_semitones'. Both the stretch and the pitch shift go to the drums and the accompaniment with the same values ('augment_pitch_scope': 'all'), so a variant is the whole arrangement in a new key at a new tempo; the shared rate is what keeps the two frame-aligned. Set 'augment_pitch_scope' to 'controls' to hold the drums at their original tuning while still re-keying the accompaniment. Each variant is a fresh pass, so the stochastic stem submix is re-rolled per variant too. Encode time and disk scale with the variant count. Sanity check: 'sanity_check_samples' is counted PER VARIANT and the dataloader is unshuffled, so 2 x 'augment_variants' items are decoded back to audio into <output_path>/_sanity_check — the same tracks in every variant, so the variants are A/B-able against each other. Build the page with scripts/make_listening_page.py; each variant gets its own card stating the rate and interval it was written with.
